mutants.description: The out-of-range marker is published to prev_period as soon as period_counter saturates, mid-period, instead of when the next rising edge closes the stalled period.
mutants.reason: If pwm_sync stalls (high or low) long enough to saturate the counter, prev_period changes to all-ones during the stall instead of keeping the last complete period. In the original it changes only at the next rising edge, and never changes if no rising edge comes.

mutants.description: 'Both captured from the same counter run' is misread as 'both captured at the same rising edge', so duty_count is also loaded with the full period count at every rising edge.
mutants.reason: After each rising edge, duty_count equals prev_period (the whole switching period) until the next falling edge overwrites it. During the HS phase the host reads 100% duty, and if PWM stalls high it keeps reading that value.
